suite: Sample databases (AdventureWorks): equivalent pairs and siblings
metric: Authored pairs on the AdventureWorks schema under its declared keys, labelled equivalent or different (each 'different' label has a witness database); 13 siblings drop one key, foreign key or NOT NULL the equivalence needs. Provers: structural, algebraic/SMT with the declared constraints and its counterexample search, then the bounded checker for a counterexample.
correctness: 0 wrong: every proof also gives the same result on the real data and no proof is of a pair labelled different; every refutation's counterexample, completed with legal values, satisfies the declared constraints and separates the pair when replayed in DuckDB
held_out: 5/5 proved, 4/6 refuted, 0 wrong (a fifth of the pairs by SHA-1 of their id)
caveats: Authored pairs (67; dev 56, held out 11), not from upstream. Constraint siblings refuted: 11/13. The algebraic prover's executed counterexample search is time-limited, so on a loaded machine a refutation can fall back to unknown. No prover was changed for this eval. The first full run is the baseline (nothing tuned): 24/28 proved, 33/39 refuted, 0 wrong; the recorded run refuted one fewer (3 DISTINCT pairs flipped between refuted and unknown).
